headline: Giants QB Jaxson Dart Could Undergo Season-Ending Knee Surgery
summary: The knee injury that knocked Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart out of their Week 2 loss to the Rams on Monday is worse than initially feared, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. headline: Sources: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks set for surgery, IR move
summary: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks is expected to undergo surgery to repair a core muscle injury and is set to miss at least six weeks, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Bears QB Tyson Bagent In Concussion Protocol
summary: The Bears may have to turn to third-string quarterback Case Keenum next Monday against the Eagles. Backup Tyson Bagent, who had been set to start in place of the injured Caleb Williams, is in concussion protocol, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Bagent’s status for Week 3 is up in the air. headline: Packers Unsure If WR Jayden Reed Will Return This Season
summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said on Tuesday (via ESPN’s Rob Demovsky) that it was “way too early” to make any prognostications about wide receiver Jayden Reed’s potential to return to the field this season. headline: Macdonald says Broncos' Payton accused Seahawks of cheating
summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the Broncos wrongfully accused Seattle of a Spygate-like cheating scandal in 2024. Denver coach Sean Payton ultimately "backed off" after the Seahawks threatened a lawsuit if the Broncos went public with the allegation.

headline: Michael Penix: Being healthy was my target, I feel I'm where I want to be
summary: Michael Penix is set to make his first start for the Falcons since last November when the team faces the Packers on Thursday night and the quarterback shared his excitement about that return during a press conference on Tuesday.
